answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 27 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in gale, verified in pearl, and zephyr names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Repeating the trick 20 times costs 31 separate deposits and 10 separate proofs of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
